title: Winter and Room
author: Juniper Halloran
blurb: Beatrix Okonkwo, a folklorist recording songs the village refuses to sing twice, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. Then the childhood imaginary friend is waiting on the porch, unchanged — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in before the well refills.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
